progress.title: What students see
progress.lede: What your learners are told about their own progress. Nothing here changes what you see.
progress.sub: Applies to every learner of this school.
progress.failed: We could not load this school's settings.
progress.readOnly: Only an owner or an administrator can change this.

position.label: Tell learners where they stand in their group
position.onHint: Each learner sees one sentence — “you are around the middle of your group”. Never a rank, a percentile, a classmate's result, or the group's median.
position.offHint: Learners are told nothing about the group. They still see what is worth working on next.

recipe.title: Lesson recipe
recipe.lead1: {kind, select, solo {A lesson recipe is your teaching standard: a short list of rules about what every lesson should contain. It applies to every lesson in all your courses. Any course can switch to its own recipe, or to none, in its settings.} other {A lesson recipe is your school’s teaching standard: a short list of rules about what every lesson should contain. It applies to every lesson in every course of this workspace. Any course can switch to its own recipe, or to none, in its settings.}}
recipe.lead2: The recipe never blocks publishing. When a lesson misses a rule, its author sees an amber dot <dot></dot> on the lesson in the course tree and a line in the coverage report.
recipe.failed: We could not load the lesson recipe.

readonly.title: View only. Owners and content admins can change the lesson recipe.
readonly.who: Ask an owner or a content admin if a rule should change.

never.title: {kind, select, solo {No recipe yet, so lessons in your courses are not checked.} other {No recipe yet, so lessons in this workspace are not checked.}}
never.body: Pick a preset to start. You can change every rule before saving, and nothing is checked until you save.

presets.title: Start from a preset
presets.note: Picking a preset replaces the rules below. You can undo it, and nothing is saved until you press Save.

line.balanced_a1_a2: Something heard, something written, no more than 60% picked from a list.
line.exam_b1: Reading, listening and writing every lesson; picking capped at 50%.
line.grammar_intensive: Mostly grammar, retrieved rather than recognised.

rules.title: Rules

emptyNever.title: No rules yet
emptyNever.body: Pick a preset above, or add a rule yourself. A recipe with no rules means lessons are not checked.

empty.title: No rules: lessons will not be checked
empty.body: That is a valid choice. Saving turns the check off for every course that follows this recipe. Pick a preset or add a rule to turn it back on.

rules.limit: {max} of {max} rules. That is the most a recipe can hold. Remove a rule to add another.

rule.heading: Rule {n}
rule.phraseMin: at least {n, plural, one {# item} other {# items}}
rule.axisLabel: Rule {n} — What the rule counts by
rule.notLabel: Rule {n} — Count everything except the ticked values

advise.title: What this recipe will advise
advise.sub: When a lesson misses a rule, its author sees this in the tip on the amber dot.
advise.moreLabel: Show {count} more exercise types for rule {n}
advise.recording: or turn on a recording in an exercise
advise.none: No exercise type closes this yet.
advise.fix: Fix rule {n} to see what closes it.

bar.invalid: {count, plural, one {Rule {list} needs a fix before you can save.} other {Rules {list} need a fix before you can save.}}
bar.error: Couldn’t save. Check your connection and try again.
bar.errorSub: Your edits are still here. Nothing was changed in your courses.
bar.rejectedAll: Not saved: the server didn’t accept the recipe.
bar.caption: {kind, select, solo {Saving re-checks every lesson in all your courses right away. Nothing is blocked from publishing.} other {Saving re-checks every lesson in every course that follows this recipe right away. Nothing is blocked from publishing.}}

toast.saved: {kind, select, solo {Recipe saved. Lesson notes in your courses are up to date.} other {Recipe saved. Lesson notes in every course that follows it are up to date.}}
toast.added: {preset} added. Review the rules, then save.

courses.title: Courses
courses.sub: {kind, select, solo {How your {n} courses use the recipe.} other {How the {n} courses in this workspace use the recipe.}}
courses.follow: {kind, select, solo {Follow your recipe} other {Follow this recipe}}
courses.never: {n, plural, one {The one course inherits the workspace recipe. Until one is saved, nothing is checked.} other {All # courses inherit the workspace recipe. Until one is saved, nothing is checked.}}
courses.modeOwn: {count, plural, one {Own recipe · # rule} other {Own recipe · # rules}}
